description: FHIR-first, read-only MCP server for the Practice Fusion EHR. Connects Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client to a Practice Fusion Open FHIR account to search patients and providers and review appointments, conditions, medications, labs, vitals, allergies, immunizations, encounters, documents, coverage, and a pre-visit summary via $everything. Audit-logged, HIPAA-conscious, MIT.
